protocol: Uniform-random developer (per-cell sampling over 6 land-use classes), n=5 replicates with seeds 42+1000*s (s=0..4), 50 episodes per replicate, metrics from get_metrics(), ddof=1 aggregation across replicate means -- identical to the Heuristic row of Table 5.2.

paired.description: Common random numbers: every arm uses np.random.default_rng(seed) for the developer grids (identical grids across arms) and reseeds Python random and global np.random with seed*1000+episode before every episode. Replicate-level tests use the 5 replicate means (paired t, df=4); episode-level tests use the 250 aligned episodes (paired t and Wilcoxon signed-rank). Holm adjustment across the 9 metrics is applied to the replicate-level paired t-test p-values within each contrast.

determinism_selftest.description: heuristic arm, seed 42, first episodes recomputed in 2 further independent worker processes and compared with the main run
